import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_85/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_85/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Clean 'Mouse ID' in source0: remove leading letter and convert to int
source0['Mouse ID'] = source0['Mouse ID'].str.extract('(\d+)').astype(int)

# Clean 'Mouse ID' in source1: remove leading letter and convert to int
source1['Mouse ID'] = source1['Mouse ID'].str.extract('(\d+)').astype(int)

# Join source0 and source1 on 'Mouse ID'
joined = pd.merge(source1, source0[['Mouse ID', 'Timepoint']], on='Mouse ID', how='inner')

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema: ['Drug', 'Timepoint', 'Mouse ID']
target2_85 = joined[['Drug', 'Timepoint', 'Mouse ID']]

# Ensure 'Drug' is string, 'Timepoint' and 'Mouse ID' are integers
target2_85['Drug'] = target2_85['Drug'].astype(str)
target2_85['Timepoint'] = target2_85['Timepoint'].astype(int)
target2_85['Mouse ID'] = target2_85['Mouse ID'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified path without the index column
target2_85.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_85/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
